setup_source_api.injection_point: BatchSimulator(setup_source=...) -> consulted once per created game in _build_slot; nothing after game creation reads it
setup_source_api.interface: assign(root_seed, environment_id, generation, slot_seed, game_id) -> SetupAssignment(red_setup, blue_setup, provenance)

training_source.side_seed_derivation: derive_stream_seed('setup_source_v1:side', split, profile, root_seed, environment_id, generation, player_name); one domain-separated stream per (logical game, side)

setup_source_api.split_rule: purpose='training' is locked to split='train'; a validation or test source requires purpose='evaluation_audit' plus a non-empty access_justification, checked at construction

provenance_sidecar.player_sampler_fields: the complete frozen setup_sampler_v1 provenance record, stored verbatim so rebuild_from_provenance reconstructs the sample
provenance_sidecar.note: a sibling file of the shards, never part of one; a Phase 6 shard remains readable by everything that could read it before

seeds.side_seed_derivation: derive_stream_seed('setup_source_v1:side', split, profile, root_seed, environment_id, generation, player_name); one domain-separated stream per (logical game, side)

setup_source.side_seed_derivation: derive_stream_seed('setup_source_v1:side', split, profile, root_seed, environment_id, generation, player_name); one domain-separated stream per (logical game, side)

validation.justification: Phase 7 Agent 5 explicit validation-split access smoke request; separate directory, never merged into the training campaign

test.justification: Phase 7 Agent 5 explicit test-split access smoke request; separate directory, never merged into the training campaign

design.schedule: 4 workers, the same phases driven as two 700-step pools
design.recycle_segment: segment_root_seed(base, 1); one run at 4 workers and a cold replay at 2 workers
design.gate: for every logical game identity (environment_id, generation) present in both runs, identical engine setups, fingerprints, base ids, reflection bits and perturbation seeds
design.not_compared: model action histories; float16 batch-shape effects are out of scope for a setup-assignment gate

microbenchmark.cold_library_load_note: once per worker process at startup; excluded from the per-call figures above

claims: the shared transport carries no setup or provenance field
the published observation equals build_observation(state, mover)
the model is called with exactly one observation tensor
no live provenance value is reachable from the model inputs
no live provenance value is reachable from the coordinator
observer_safety.positive_control: the same reachability walk finds every provenance value when one record is deliberately attached
